limitations: These are filtered retained original records, not full verbose logs and not regenerated synthetic log rows.
Hashes bind the retained bytes and historical source identities but are not standalone remote cryptographic attestation.
The filtering policy does not intentionally omit errors,retries,failures,metrics,consensus,detector,privacy or unknown event types.
Other studies, GPT logs and the8 original failed-attempt worker streams are outside this selected log copy; their other evidence remains separate.

policy.always_keep: errors, retries, failures, all metric/consensus/detector/privacy records, unknown types
drop_only: transfer_message_sent with integer retry_count exactly zero

representation: Plain UTF-8 JSONL containing byte-identical retained original event records. Decompressed from the recorded gzip sources without rewriting lines; full verbose source logs remain incomplete.

validation.seed_interpretation: No seed fields occur in the selected streams. Public experiment/model seeds are distinct from secure sampler/noise secrets.
